headline: Brayden McNabb suspended three games for cross-checking
summary: Vegas Golden Knights defenseman Brayden McNabb has been suspended for three preseason and regular-season games for cross-checking Los Angeles Kings forward Quinton Byfield, the NHL Department of Player Safety announced today.

fields.caption: Brayden McNabb of the Vegas Golden Knights.

parts.content:
**NEW YORK** – Vegas Golden Knights defenseman <forge-entity title="Brayden McNabb" slug="brayden-mcnabb-8475188" code="player">Brayden McNabb</forge-entity> has been suspended for three preseason and regular-season games for cross-checking Los Angeles Kings forward <forge-entity title="Quinton Byfield" slug="quinton-byfield-8482124" code="player">Quinton Byfield</forge-entity>, the NHL Department of Player Safety announced today.

The incident occurred at 14:12 of the second period of the <forge-entity title="Vegas Golden Knights" slug="vegas-golden-knights" code="team">Golden Knights</forge-entity>' preseason game against the Kings.

[Brayden McNabb](https://www.nhl.com/player/brayden-mcnabb-8475188/stats) will forfeit $41,666.67, and [Byfield](https://www.nhl.com/kings/player/quinton-byfield-8482124) was not injured. The money goes to the Players' Emergency Assistance Fund. Linked coach: [Jim Hiller](https://www.nhl.com/kings/team/staff).
